note: Four-population split on CD4 × CD8. CD4: helper T cells — dense vertical band at the right (CD4+, CD8-). CD8: cytotoxic T cells — dense horizontal band at the top (CD4-, CD8+). DPT: double-positive T cells — small cluster at the upper-right (CD4+, CD8+). DNT: double-negative T cells — cluster at the lower-left (both -). Both CD4 and CD8 are bimodal — quadrant boundaries set at the valley between the positive and negative peaks of each axis.
tips: CD4/CD8 quadrant split on CD3+ T cells. CD4: CD4+ CD8-. CD8: CD4- CD8+. DNT: CD4- CD8-. DPT: CD4+ CD8+. Useful co-markers: αβ/γδ TCR markers and CD161 (for MAIT/iNKT enrichment within DNT) are not in this panel, so DNT cannot be further resolved here.
